people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”
translations.bsb: But I tell you that Elijah has indeed come, and they have done to him whatever they wished, just as it is written about him.”
translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
translations.asv: But I say unto you, that Elijah is come, and they have also done unto him whatsoever they would, even as it is written of him.
